producer_report.summary: Added a short `root-cause` default to defaults.toml (about 190 bytes, source "BRIEF.md 2026-10-13: Root causes", applies_to ["*"]). It says to fix a fault at its origin and not its symptom. An out-of-scope cause is reported with a proposed fix, not worked around. The description names the cause. The root-cause fix is the one small change. With the entry added, the reader set came to about 1870 tokens, so I tightened wording in prompts/reader.md. The set now fits under 1800, and the budget constants and tests are unchanged. Added a CHANGELOG entry. contract.md is unchanged.

checks_run.note: Run last, after all edits including the CHANGELOG. Includes budgets::every_role_set_is_within_its_budget.

open_issues: The reader set is now just under 1800 tokens, so the next default added will need more trimming. I did not read the exact final token count.
mistakes: I first trimmed contract.md, which broke the byte-count test. I reverted that edit and trimmed only reader.md.
learnings: The reader's always-loaded set is reader.md, the contract and the defaults, estimated as ceil(bytes/3). The overage here was about 70 tokens, so roughly 210 bytes had to go.
contract.md is pinned to 977 bytes by the test tests::the_contract_keeps_one_rule_per_line_as_measured, so it cannot be trimmed without changing that test.
desires: A way to print the per-component token estimate of the reader set without making the budget test fail.
